title: Adda247 Alternative for Educators (2026): Own Your Brand
description: For SSC, banking and railway educators at or leaving Adda247: what Adda247 publishes, what to check in your contract, and how to relaunch your exam content under your name.

dek: Adda247 is a large exam-prep brand that educators teach for, not software you subscribe to. This guide is for SSC, banking and railway educators deciding what to do next, using only what each side publishes.

intro: For an educator at Adda247, the alternative is to sell your exam teaching under your own name: your own website on your own domain and your own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), with fresh courses and test series you create for it, once you have checked what your contract allows. Adda247 calls itself "India's Largest Vernacular Learning Platform (Online Courses, Mocks, Books)". It is a brand you teach for, not software you buy, so the real choice is between staying, relaunching on your own, or both.

Teaching for a big exam-prep brand has real value. You reach aspirants across many languages, you learn to teach to camera at scale, and someone else runs marketing, technology and sales. Your own academy gives you a name, a price and a student list that stay with you, and makes finding students your job.

We are AllCoaching, and we sell the software for the second path, so read this knowing who wrote it. We quote Adda247 and Testbook only from their own websites, checked on 24 Oct 2026, and we say where staying is the better choice.

sections.h2: The short answer: stay, relaunch, or do both
sections.html:
An educator looking for an Adda247 alternative has three real options: stay with a big exam-prep brand, relaunch under your own name, or do both if your contract allows. Staying suits an educator who values reach and a team. Relaunching suits an educator whose students already ask for them by name.

{{fig:verdict|Adda247 alternative for educators by need: sell under your own name, your own academy on AllCoaching; big audience and a team, stay at Adda247; marketing handled elsewhere, Testbook Partner Faculty; audience first, YouTube|Pick the row that sounds like you.}}

Whichever you pick, start by reading your contract. It decides what you can take, when you can start, and what you can teach elsewhere.

sections.h2: Why educators look for an Adda247 alternative
sections.html:
Educators who look for an Adda247 alternative usually want their own name to grow, not to escape the work. Here is what a big brand gives, and what to think through before you move.

What a big exam-prep brand does well

Adda247 offers government-exam and upskilling preparation in many languages, with online courses, mocks and books.[1] For an educator, that means a large audience, production at scale and a team handling marketing and sales. Many educators learn to teach to camera inside companies like this, and that experience is worth a lot.

1. What you can take, and what stays

Your agreement decides who owns the videos, PDFs, mocks and question banks you made while working there. Read it before you plan anything. Your teaching method, your shortcuts and your name are yours; the files you made for a company may not be. The safe default is to create fresh material for your own academy.

{{q:Can I build my own academy while I still work at the company?|It depends on your contract. Some agreements include exclusivity, non-compete or notice-period terms. Adda247 does not publish its educator terms, so we cannot say what yours contains. Read it, ask the company in writing if anything is unclear, or speak to a lawyer. This guide is not legal advice.}}

2. A known face at a new address

Aspirants who learned SSC maths or banking reasoning from you often follow you by name on YouTube or Instagram. When you open your own academy, telling them where to find you is usually the fastest way to your first students.

3. Setting your own price and language

On your own academy you decide the price of each series and course, and you can teach in Hindi, Bengali, Tamil or any language your aspirants prefer. See teaching in regional Indian languages.

4. One place instead of many

Educators who start alone often stitch together a live-class app, Drive folders and UPI screenshots. One academy login replaces that from the first day.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after for an exam educator relaunching alone: classes on YouTube Live, PDFs in Drive folders, fees on UPI screenshots, mocks on Google Forms, doubts on WhatsApp, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes, checkout and tests|Start your own academy in one place, not five.}}

sections.h2: What relaunching under your own name costs
sections.html:
Adda247 does not publish what it pays educators, so a pay-versus-cost comparison is not possible and we will not invent one. What we can show is what your own academy costs at different sales levels, from AllCoaching's published prices.

  • ₹1 lakh of sales a year: ₹16,999 for the year on Starter (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹4 lakh of sales a year: ₹42,999 for the year on Growth (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹10 lakh of sales a year: ₹74,999 for the year on Pro (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).

Each figure uses whichever plan costs least at that level: Starter ₹6,999 + 10% below ₹2.4 lakh of sales, Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5% from ₹2.4 to ₹4.8 lakh, Pro ₹24,999 + 5% from ₹4.8 to ₹15 lakh, and Scale ₹99,999 + 0% above ₹15 lakh.

An illustrative relaunch: a ₹500 SSC CGL mock series sold to 200 aspirants (₹1 lakh) plus a ₹3,000 recorded quant course sold to 100 (₹3 lakh) is ₹4 lakh of sales. On Growth, the year costs ₹42,999 before GST. The figures are illustrative and assume you can reach those aspirants.

Weigh that against a regular income from a company. Many educators keep their role until their own academy covers their monthly costs.

faq: How can I move away from Adda247 and sell my exam content under my own name?

Read your contract first, then build your own academy with fresh content and announce it to the aspirants who already follow you. On AllCoaching every plan includes a website on your own domain and your own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), from ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales, GST extra, after a 14-day free trial.
What can I take with me when I leave a big exam-prep company?

Your contract decides that. Videos, PDFs and question banks made for the company may be covered by the agreement, while your method and your name stay yours. Read it, and ask in writing or a lawyer if it is unclear. This guide is not legal advice.
Does Adda247 publish what it pays educators?
No. We found no educator programme page or published pay on adda247.com (checked 24 Oct 2026). Ask for the terms in writing.
Will I lose my students if I leave?
Students who know you by name often follow you when you tell them where to find you. Students who came for the company's brand may stay there. Plan to rebuild, starting with your own followers.
Can I prepare my own academy while I still work at the company?
Only if your contract allows it. Check exclusivity and non-compete terms first, and ask in writing if they are unclear.
Should I launch a test series or a course first?
A test series is often quicker: mocks are fast to create and aspirants can judge your questions at once. Add a recorded course behind it.
How much does it cost to relaunch on AllCoaching?

Starter is ₹6,999 a year plus 10% of sales, Growth ₹12,999 plus 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 plus 5% and Scale ₹99,999 at 0%, GST extra, after a 14-day free trial. At ₹4 lakh of sales a year, the total is ₹42,999 on Growth.
How do aspirants find me without the company's app?
Through your own YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp and search, usually starting with a free mock. AllCoaching also lists your courses on its marketplace app for discovery.
